name: MSR retail / Dreamcast
purpose: Evidence and implementation guide for native adapters; not importable as a generic 9XD Mesh Profile.
status: Native Pak/Bizarre extraction and separate retail track adapter with companion textures; retail vehicles and yzb_ wrappers pending

container: Validate Pak magic and declared decoded size; preserve original compressed bytes.
Determine codec using decoded alpha structural invariants, not the same filename alone.
geometry: Validate hierarchy, pointer origin, vertex encoding and strip boundaries after decompression.
dependencies: DYP/DYT and NTP/NTT are separate variants; texture/geometry roles must be checked from decoded headers.

limitations: Do not pass compressed bytes to the alpha parser.
No faces or automatic settings claimed.

compression.algorithm: 30 MSB-first flags per UInt32; low two control bits select 14-mode distance bits; UInt16 match distance=(token&mask)+1 length=(token>>bits)+3
compression.validation: Native bounded extraction tests against supplied Pak resources; do not use alpha geometry declarations for decoded retail data.

retailTrack.validation: Independent strips, bounded BSP nodes, local centers, finite coordinates and per-corner UVs. Invalid UV groups retain untextured geometry.
retailTrack.tested: Asakusa day: 77617 valid triangles, 466 texture directory entries, native GLB export.
